pins.head: START WITH ONE CUBE SHELF
pins.sub: Budget Organizing, One Unit at a Time
pins.title: Organize a Small Apartment on a Budget, Starting With One Cube Shelf
pins.desc: Buying a whole system at once is how a budget disappears before the flat is any tidier. One open cube unit does three jobs on its own: it holds books on the side you see, takes fabric bins for the things you do not, and stands away from the wall as a divider. Live with it for a fortnight before adding the next piece. Contains affiliate links. #SmallApartment #BudgetOrganizing #CubeStorage
pins.alt: A white cube shelf holding books and coral and teal fabric bins, standing beside a grey armchair in a sunlit apartment with a plant on the windowsill.

pins.head: MEASURE THE POUR FIRST
pins.sub: Sizing a Resin Kit to the Job
pins.title: Epoxy Resin Kit Size: Work Out the Pour Before You Buy the Kit
pins.desc: A small kit and a large one cost close to the same per ounce, so the real question is how much you will mix before the rest goes off. Fill the mold with water, tip that into a measuring cup and read the volume, then buy for two or three of those pours rather than for the year. Resin left open loses its clarity long before it runs out. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #EpoxyResin #ResinCrafts
pins.alt: Two resin bottles, one cream and one amber, standing beside three graduated mixing cups of different sizes on a wood workbench.

pins.head: KEEP THE PUMP, SWAP THE POUCH
pins.title: Shampoo and Body Wash Refills: Keep the Pump, Replace the Pouch
pins.desc: A refill pouch is only the cheaper option if it fits the bottle already on your counter. Check the pouch volume against the pump you own, then work out the price per ounce for the pouch and for a fresh bottle side by side. Keeping one pump in service also means one fewer empty bottle leaving the bathroom each month. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomRefills #RefillPouch #PersonalCare
pins.alt: Two pump bottles, one amber and one white, standing on a white bathroom counter beside a large cream refill pouch, with a rolled towel behind them by the window.

pins.head: RAISE IT AND GAIN THE GAP
pins.sub: A Riser Is Storage, Not Just Height
pins.title: Small Home Office: A Monitor Riser Gives You Back the Desk Under It
pins.desc: Raising the screen to eye level is the ergonomic reason, but the useful part is the gap it opens underneath. A keyboard slides in there when the desk has to become a table, and a riser with a drawer takes the pens and chargers that otherwise live on the surface. The desk gains a second level without getting any wider. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOffice #MonitorRiser #DeskOrganization
pins.alt: A wood desk against a pale wall with a monitor raised on a riser, a teal desk lamp, a small plant and a teal office chair, beside a bright window.

pins.head: ONE LONG ROLL GOES FURTHER
pins.title: Permanent Adhesive Vinyl by the Roll: More Yield, Fewer Offcuts
pins.desc: Square sheets waste whatever is left around the edge of each one. A single long roll lets you nest the next cut hard against the last, so the scrap is the width of a blade instead of a border on four sides. Work out the square feet a typical project takes before you decide between a sheet bundle and a roll. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CricutProjects #CraftSupplies
pins.alt: Two rolls of adhesive craft vinyl in sage and cream lying on a grey cutting mat with cut sheets, a notepad and a calculator on a wood workbench.

pins.head: THE GAP BESIDE THE TOILET
pins.sub: A Narrow Cart Fits Where Nothing Else Does
pins.title: Small Bathroom Storage: The Narrow Gap Beside the Toilet Is Shelving
pins.desc: The strip of floor next to the toilet is usually too narrow for a cabinet and ends up holding nothing at all. A slim rolling cart fits it, carries the spare rolls and folded towels, and pulls straight out when you need to clean behind it. Measure the clear width at the narrowest point rather than at the wall, because the cistern normally sticks out further. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomStorage #SmallBathroom #RenterFriendly
pins.alt: A small bathroom with a white rolling cart of towels and spare rolls beside the toilet, a shelf of woven baskets under the window and a coral towel hanging on the door hooks.

pins.head: WASH IT BEFORE IT SETS
pins.title: Paint Brush Care: Wash, Reshape and Rack Before the Acrylic Sets
pins.desc: What ruins a brush is not the painting, it is the acrylic that dries up inside the ferrule while the brush sits in a jar. Rinse it while the paint is still wet, work the soap out at the base rather than the tip, pull the point back into shape with your fingers, and put it in a rack instead of leaving it on a cloth with the others. Contains affiliate links. #PaintBrushCare #AcrylicPainting #ArtStudio
pins.alt: A wooden brush rack holding several fine paintbrushes upright on a pale workbench, with a glass jar and a folded grey cloth beside it.

pins.head: SORT IT WHERE IT LANDS
pins.sub: A Divided Hamper by the Bed
pins.title: Small Bedroom Organization: Sort the Laundry Where It Comes Off
pins.desc: One basket means sorting the whole pile later, on the floor, in the room with the least space to do it. A divided hamper on wheels takes darks, lights and colours as they come off, rolls out on wash day and goes back into the same corner. The floor stays clear because nothing is waiting to be dealt with. Contains affiliate links. #SmallBedroom #LaundrySorting #BedroomOrganization
pins.alt: A wood nightstand with a lamp, a mug and a pair of glasses beside the edge of a teal bed, with a navy three-section laundry sorter on wheels standing against the wall.

pins.head: COUNT THE CUPS, NOT THE BAG
pins.title: Coffee Quantity Planning: Count Cups per Month Before You Reorder
pins.desc: A bag is sold by weight and a box of pods by the lid, but you drink neither of those. Multiply the cups you make a day by thirty, work out how many cups your usual dose gets from one bag, and order to the month from there. Buying to the month rather than to the shelf is what keeps beans from going stale in the cupboard. Contains affiliate links. #CoffeeAtHome #CoffeePods #GroceryPlanning
pins.alt: A kraft coffee bag on a pale counter beside a small stack of coloured coffee pods, a calculator, a notepad and a pencil.

pins.head: A BENCH AND A ROW OF HOOKS
pins.sub: The Whole Entryway in Two Pieces
pins.title: Renter Entryway Storage: A Bench and a Hook Rail Do Almost All of It
pins.desc: An entryway only has to deal with coats, bags and the shoes that come off at the door. A row of hooks carries the first two, a narrow bench takes the sitting down, and baskets pushed under it swallow the shoes. Everything stands on the floor or leaves fixings small enough to fill on the last day of the lease. Contains affiliate links. #EntrywayIdeas #RenterFriendly #SmallSpaceStorage
pins.alt: A row of wall hooks holding teal and coral coats and a tote bag above a wood bench, with two woven baskets underneath and a patterned runner on the floor.

pins.head: SPARES GO IN THE DRAWER
pins.title: Fluoride Whitening Toothpaste: Buy the Multipack, Store It in the Drawer
pins.desc: A multipack only saves anything if the spares end up somewhere you will actually find them. Keep one tube out and stand the rest upright in a drawer divider, where a glance tells you when to reorder. Check the price per ounce against a single tube first, because the larger pack is not automatically the better number. Contains affiliate links. #ToothpasteStorage #BathroomOrganization #DrawerOrganizer
pins.alt: An open bamboo drawer with clear divider bins holding white toothpaste tubes standing upright beside toothbrush heads.

pins.head: PUT THE DAILY THINGS OUT
pins.sub: Open Shelves for What You Use
pins.title: Small Kitchen Organization: Leave the Everyday Dishes in the Open
pins.desc: Cupboard space in a small kitchen is worth more than a tidy-looking worktop. The plates and mugs you reach for every day can live on one open shelf where no door has to be opened, which frees a whole cupboard for the things you use twice a month. Hooks on the wall take the bags and cloths that never fit a drawer anyway. Contains affiliate links. #SmallKitchen #OpenShelving #KitchenOrganization
pins.alt: A small kitchen with an open shelf of stacked plates and bowls above the counter, a wood chopping board by the sink, a striped towel over the edge and a mesh bag hanging on a wall hook.
